title: Checks for erasing operations, e.g., x * 0.
summary: The whole expression can be replaced by zero. This is most likely not the intended outcome and should probably be corrected Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Checks for .err().expect() calls on the Result type.
summary: .expect_err() can be called directly to avoid the extra type conversion from err(). Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for types named Error that implement Error.
summary: It can become confusing when a codebase has 20 types all named Error, requiring either aliasing them in the use statement or qualifying them like my_module::Error. This hinders comprehension, as it requires you to memorize every variation of importing Error used across a codebase. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
